SSC CGL vs SSC CHSL: exam pattern compared

Both have 100 questions in 60 minutes, marked +2 / −0.5. In SSC CGL one clock runs for the whole paper; in SSC CHSL each section has its own clock (English Language 15 min, General Intelligence 15 min, Quantitative Aptitude 15 min, General Awareness 15 min). The sections are the same.

Questions people ask

What is the difference between the SSC CGL and SSC CHSL exam patterns?

Both have 100 questions in 60 minutes, marked +2 / −0.5. In SSC CGL one clock runs for the whole paper; in SSC CHSL each section has its own clock (English Language 15 min, General Intelligence 15 min, Quantitative Aptitude 15 min, General Awareness 15 min). The sections are the same.

Which has stricter negative marking, SSC CGL or SSC CHSL?

Neither: both take away a quarter of a right answer’s marks for each wrong answer (both +2 / −0.5).

Can I practise for both SSC CGL and SSC CHSL on Takkar?

Yes. Pick either exam in the app and every duel follows its marking and timing; you can switch exams any time. The quant and reasoning topics overlap a lot, so practice for one helps the other.
